static_traits.name: Lin Manning
static_traits.family_status: Living alone with a pet cat
static_traits.social_status: Interpersonal relationships: prefers Being alone, lacks intimate relationships; Social support system is weak, but can seek help from a few colleagues when needed.
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no similar psychological problems before; has not received psychotherapy/counseling.
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe events and emotions concretely; highly cooperative, positive attitude; steady speech rate; has self-criticism and catastrophizing tendencies.

basic_info.main_problem: I tend to have negative thoughts about my Work performance, especially when I make mistakes (such as mixing up orders), which leads to feelings of inadequacy and Self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: A recent event at work made me realize these negative thoughts are affecting my work performance and physical and mental health, so I sought counseling.
growth_experiences: During one Busy shift, accidentally swapped two customers' orders; one customer was very angry and complained to the manager; since then, negative Automatic thoughts have markedly increased during busy periods, often predicting further mistakes before any error has occurred, worrying about being fired; negative thinking affects sleep and diet, and worsens Self-doubt.

core_beliefs: I am not competent at work

special_situations.event: Gets a customer's order wrong during a busy shift; the customer complains to the manager
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make any mistake, it shows I am not competent at Work and will be negated by others
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Is harsher on themselves, repeatedly worries and self-criticizes, trying to avoid making mistakes again through greater tension and sustained vigilance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I messed things up, I will never do Work well

special_situations.event: Becoming tense and worried during busy periods before any error has occurred
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I feel overwhelmed, I will inevitably make mistakes and cause serious consequences
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Rehearsing worst-case scenarios in advance, constantly Self-monitoring to seek control
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will definitely make a mistake again; the consequences will be terrible

special_situations.event: Customers expressing dissatisfaction or the manager noticing mistakes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' attitudes and evaluations determine my worth; their dissatisfaction shows I am incapable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Intensifies self-blame and tension, excessive self-scrutiny to gain external recognition
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must think I am incapable / the manager is looking down on me

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized and seen as competent
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure, being negated, or even being fired
defense_goal: Avoids mistakes and criticism through self-reproach and high caution, maintaining a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: A server prone to mistakes, needing to constantly correct oneself
object_relations.object_representation: Picky customers or managers who would negate oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about or recalling Work mistakes, especially busy shifts and others' dissatisfied feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others will think I am incapable; my worth depends on their evaluation (transference: treating external dissatisfaction as negation of one's whole self)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: First acknowledge their self-blaming feelings in the conversation, respond in a gentle, supportive tone; use open-ended Questioning and specific fact-checking, avoid reinforcing self-attack; guide them to distinguish the event from self-worth.

manifestations: Preferring Being alone, lacking intimate relationships
A weaker social support system; only asks a few colleagues for help when needed
outcomes: In work-stress situations, lacks emotional buffering and support, so negative thinking cycles more easily
Increased anxiety affecting sleep and diet

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequently Self-denial when narrating mistakes (such as 'I am not good enough / incompetent')
Being overly cautious and worried when busy, constantly self-scrutinizing
Highly sensitive to potential criticism, treats others' attitudes as the basis of one's own value

exception_events.target_problem: When oversights occur at Work, the client typically keeps blaming themselves and worrying about making mistakes again, leading to greater Anxiety in subsequent shifts, Performance affected, Sleep disturbed.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Once, after forgetting to restock the coffee station, faced customer dissatisfaction; she then built the habit of 'regularly checking the coffee station', similar problems have not occurred again, and she experienced increased confidence.
exception_events.reason: Different approach: treating mistakes as clues for improvement and implementing a checking process; breaking tasks down and preparing in advance gave her a sense of control, thereby reducing catastrophizing and Anxiety.

positive_force: Positive attitude, willing to try self-help strategies (deep breathing, positive self-talk, journaling)
Able to turn mistakes into improvement measures (building checking habits)
Experience of having successfully handled busy shifts available for recall and Reinforcement
Being able to seek help from colleagues when needed
negative_force: Catastrophizing, jumping to conclusions, A cognitive pattern of overgeneralization and personalization
Self-reproach and low sense of self-worth
Weak social support, preferring Being alone
Highly sensitive to mistakes when stress is high, leading to Sleep and diet affected

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophic worry and Self-denial in Work situations (such as 'I am not good enough/will be fired')
antecedent: When an order error occurs or is recalled
Customers expressing dissatisfaction or the manager noticing mistakes
target_behavior.core_reason: After one order-mistake incident, generalizing the error into a core belief of inadequate ability, and predicting the future in a catastrophic way (worrying about being fired/never doing well).
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential failure and criticism to gain a sense of control and security (through excessive worry and Self-monitoring).
target_behavior.consequence: Increased anxiety,Work performance affected,Sleep and diet disrupted,Social withdrawal.
